queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS group_avg
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, group_avg, (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS case_avg
    FROM group_averages
    WHERE group_avg > (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase)
)
SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    ABS(group_avg - case_avg) AS absolute_difference,
    group_avg / (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM qualifying) AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_of_averages
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, o.mean_of_averages
    FROM status_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
    WHERE s.avg_modelconf > o.mean_of_averages
)
SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    ABS(avg_modelconf - mean_of_averages) AS absolute_difference,
    ABS(avg_modelconf - mean_of_averages)
        / (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) FROM qualifying) AS divided_difference
FROM qualifying

WITH all_case_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS avg_confidence
    FROM compliancecase
),
status_averages AS (
    SELECT
        brokrepstat,
        AVG(modelconf) AS avg_confidence
    FROM compliancecase
    WHERE modelconf > (SELECT avg_confidence FROM all_case_average)
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
)
SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    avg_confidence,
    avg_confidence - (SELECT avg_confidence FROM all_case_average) AS difference_from_all_case_average,
    avg_confidence / (SELECT AVG(avg_confidence) FROM status_averages) AS ratio_to_group_average_mean
FROM status_averages
